name: Ethereal Barrelband
description: Posts the two ranks a pace apart, left foot forward in the front and right foot in the rear.

name: Searing Prime
description: Fires level on the court's word, each shooter aiming along the barrel of the partner beside him.

name: Bedrock Bayonetlug
description: Stands the loader behind the shooter's shoulder, where the body and barrel together shield him.

name: Pan Mercy
description: Counts a shared pulse of qi along both ranks so that every shooter fires in the same heartbeat.

name: Statute Serpent
description: Fires front rank and rear rank in strict turn so one is always loaded while the other speaks.

name: Fuzeseal
description: Crosses two barrels at the foe's blade and knocks it aside, one man's guard covering the other's.

name: Entropy Wheellock
description: Angles the two ranks' fire to cross over the foe on one drawn count of qi.

name: Swift Flintcock
description: Advances both ranks together at the drum, one firing while the other steps through to the front.

name: Panedict
description: Narrows both ranks' fire onto one point of the foe's line and opens a gap in it.

name: Tempestuous Ramrod
description: The school's closing volley, in which two ranks fire as one court and their joined shot falls on a single chosen front.

name: Salvo Solace
description: Spaces the files an arm's reach apart so the line can spread or fold without breaking order.

name: Pealramrod
description: Sights from the end man of the line along the whole front to judge the foe's width.

name: Prismramrod
description: Fires in a quick beat with the neighbours on each side, the three shots leaving almost together.

name: Intrepid Stockbutt
description: Fires the left wing high and loud to draw the foe's eyes while the right wing moves.

name: Twilit Load
description: Sweeps the right wing round at a run, qi in the legs, to close on the foe's flank.

name: Steel Lockplate
description: Folds the line in on itself and crouches, so the enemy's fire crosses an empty space.

name: Wheellock Blessing
description: Joins the qi of the two wings by one steady breath so both fire with a single will.

name: Aim Decree
description: Spreads the line wide and fires both wings inward, filling the ground between them with shot.

name: Pulsar Stockbutt
description: Closes both wings onto a column's head and drives a hardened volley through its leading rank.

name: Smoke Verdict
description: Rakes a column from the side along its whole length with a volley carried on the joined fields of both wings.

name: Magnificent Bedrock Ramrod
description: The school's two-flank order, in which the line opens like wings to take a column in crossfire and closes on it.

name: Meteoric Pan
description: Posts each file along the bank so the rank's line follows the water's edge.

name: Ramrodmercy
description: Calls the dressing along the bank and listens for each file's answer to hear where the line sags.

name: Pulsar Aim
description: Fires level across a ford at a figure wading in the shallows, aiming at the waist to allow for the drop.

name: Rooted Touchpan
description: Kneels in standing reeds at the bank's edge so the foe sees only a stir of leaves.

name: Vigorramrod
description: Passes a single stream of qi from man to man along the rank like water over stones.

name: Imperial Serpent
description: Sends each file's shot in a rolling ripple from one end of the rank to the other.

name: Squall Flintcock
description: Wheels the whole rank around one pivot man like an eddy to meet a threat from the water.

name: Undefiled Barrelband
description: Sweeps the barrel across the body in a flowing arc, turning a cut with the stream of the motion.

name: Solarload
description: Builds a rank's fire over a long count and lets it go together, swamping the ground before the bank.

name: Lordly Touchpan
description: Keeps a steady fire on a crossing so that no foot can set down in the shallows.

name: Dunepowder
description: Releases volley on volley in one swelling surge carried by the rank's linked qi, sweeping a whole bank.

name: Gloom Salvo
description: The school's doctrine of firing as a river flows, each volley passing to the next until the whole line has spoken.

name: Skyborne Load
description: Posts the line in two tracks, one loading and one firing, with a pace between them.

name: Gracious Stockbutt
description: Calls the turn of each track in a steady chant so that no man has to look for it.

name: Intrepid Powder
description: Fires on one's own track's turn and no other, holding the aim through the neighbour's report.

name: Fuzegift
description: Passes the empty piece to the loading track and takes the loaded one in a single exchange.

name: Powdervoyage
description: Advances with both tracks locked at one pace apart, qi keeping the interval exact.

name: Unwavering Bayonetlug
description: Lets the firing track fall back behind the loading track's raised bayonets when the foe closes.

name: Fuzebanner
description: Lets both tracks fire in rotation for a long minute until the foe's line cannot move.

name: Imperial Prime
description: Splits the two tracks' aim to opposite halves of the foe's front on one drawn count of qi.

name: Radiance Smoke
description: Drives both tracks' fire into the same file of the foe's line, shattering its centre.

name: Resonant Tenet Smoke
description: The school's capstone drill, in which both tracks fire, load and advance in one unbroken sequence, giving the foe no pause.

name: Dunesalvo
description: Settles the body into a stance that lets the qi field spread evenly from the ground upward.

name: Vigor Flintcock
description: Seats the charge and ball with the field wrapped around the bore, so nothing sits crooked.

name: Powderdecree
description: Aims along a straight line of qi drawn from eye to mark and fires on it.

name: Merciful Lockplate
description: Ties the barrel to the body with a band of qi that takes up all its weight and its kick.

name: Radiance Wheellock
description: Lines the ball's path with a thin trail of field, keeping its flight straight to the mark.

name: Sainted Barrelband
description: Throws a patch of field over the shoulder and arm that is hit by a stray ball.

name: Eclipse Bayonetlug
description: Feels a man's approach where he crosses the edge of the field, before the eye can find him.

name: Powderedict
description: Fires a hardened shot through the cover of a line of men as the field closes round the ball.

name: Bedrock Load
description: Opens the whole field outward and bursts a charge of small shot across a broad front.

name: Intrepid Lockplate
description: Packs the master's field behind one ball and drives it through a stout barricade as through a door.

name: Heroic Squall Serpent
description: The school's capstone shot, in which the master's whole field is drawn into one ball and released at the farthest reach.

name: Spectral Aim
description: Stands with the weight sunk to the lower belly, where the Core sits, and the barrel rides still.

name: Panbenison
description: Times the sight to the slow steady pulse of the Core, letting the shot break between its beats.

name: Radiance Salvo
description: Lets the Core's pulse hold the barrel level through the squeeze and the shot.

name: Parity Touchpan
description: Warms the hands from the Core so the load goes on smoothly in any weather.

name: Thunderclap Bayonetlug
description: Sends a single pulse of Core qi down the barrel with the ball, so it leaves hard and true.

name: Vigorpan
description: Holds a steady draw from the Core into the arms for as long as the aim must wait.

name: Squall Touchpan
description: Meets a cut with the barrel and snaps a rebound of Core qi through it, throwing the blade back.

name: Swift Aim
description: Steps clear of a charge while the Core's surge makes the load finish in half the usual time.

name: Vacuum Prime
description: Feeds the ball from the Core until it pierces a shield and the plate behind it.

name: Storied Powder
description: Draws a count of Core qi through the barrel and scatters a charge of small shot in a wide fan.

name: Radiance Ramrod
description: Compresses a heartbeat of the formed Core into the ball and breaks a masonry parapet's face at the musket's reach.

name: Imperial Pan
description: The school's capstone, in which the Core's pulse becomes the aim and one ball leaves with the Core's full weight behind it.
